verdict.rationale: Viam documents its own model pipeline: you can bring your own model, push models to machines for local inference with versioning and rollback, and use logic modules that read from a camera and command an arm. That is a plausible path for plugging learned models into the control loop. However, nothing in the evidence mentions vision-language-action or robotics foundation models, or any tooling built for them, so support for this specific story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit VLA/foundation-model support or integrations, documentation of models producing actions rather than just detection/classification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
